boundaries: Scale measurements are existing untimed helper snapshots, not replicated peaks or whole-machine memory.

Sparse carrier saves 36KiB versus materialized copied core for an already-prepared native deployment; user-only owner cost can outweigh that saving.
Original host native code remains; no measured host-kernel replacement or whole-machine net saving.
